title: Turkish Indirect Reported Speech
summary: Reporting what someone said or what happened.
explanation: Turkish turns reported clauses into nominalized structures using participle suffixes (-dik) plus possessive and accusative markers.

example_translations.ex_trind_1: He/She said that he/she read the book.

common_error_explanations.err_trind_1: Use nominalized participle clauses for reported speech.
